result.instructions: Tools for Veracross, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the students in grade 7 and their homerooms."; "Which classes does Alex Morgan have this year, and who teaches them?"; "Show the numeric grades posted for the Biology class this term.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Veracross data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run veracross_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run veracross_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run veracross_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. veracross_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: veracross_list_students
tools.title: List students
tools.description: List students (person records with grade level, homeroom, household and enrollment status). Data API: GET /students. Scope: students:list.

role.description: Role filter (role name as the school uses it).

on_or_after_last_modified_date.description: Only records last modified on or after this date (as the API expects, e.g. 2026-01-01).

on_or_before_last_modified_date.description: Only records last modified on or before this date (as the API expects, e.g. 2026-12-31).

page_size.description: Records per page (X-Page-Size). Omit for the API default.
